data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** dc3b288e5831592d4a69f58004fc91a14e5d465b
* **script:** plugins/dso/hooks/record-test-status.sh
* **state file:** .test-index

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When a test transitions from RED → GREEN (i.e., a test previously marked with `[test_name]` in .test-index now passes), record-test-status.sh should clean up the stale marker automatically. The marker exists to track 'this test is expected to fail because the feature isn't implemented yet'; once the test passes, the marker has served its purpose.

#### Actual Behavior

Session of 2026-05-12, commit cycle for review-defense-store fix (965d59bb). Pre-commit produced:

```
STALE RED MARKER: tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh (marker: test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields) — all RED-zone tests passed
  To remove: sed -i.bak 's/ \[test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields\]//' .test-index && rm .test-index.bak && git add .test-index
Test status recorded: failed — failed tests: ...[stale-red-marker:test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields]
```

The pre-commit hook DETECTED the stale marker and printed the exact sed command to fix it, but did not auto-apply the fix. The commit landed (because compliance verifier passed downstream of this warning), but a subsequent commit would have failed the test gate. Manual workaround:

```
sed -i.bak 's/ \[test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields\]//' .test-index && rm .test-index.bak && git add .test-index
```

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* Hook: plugins/dso/hooks/record-test-status.sh
* File: .test-index
* Fix sketch: when record-test-status.sh detects a stale marker AND `DSO_COMMIT_WORKFLOW=1` is set, auto-apply the cleanup sed (stage the .test-index modification into the commit). Optional: gate behind a config knob like `test_index.auto_cleanup_stale_markers=true` for users who prefer manual.

* Related: this also affects sprint Phase 5 Step 10a 'RED marker cleanup (before closure)' — that step instructs the orchestrator to run `grep -n "\[.*\]" .test-index` and manually remove markers. Same fix could automate both.
data.title: [record-test-status.sh,.test-index]: stale RED marker for GREEN test -> blocks commit; requires manual sed cleanup
